scenes.title: App Toolkit
scenes.action: One shape per tool arrives on each note in its world's colour; the App Toolkit icon pops, the shapes breathe round it and the name and line land.

scenes.title: Water Eject
scenes.action: The water world grows out of the intro's blue shape. The phone stands with its speaker down, as the sheet asks; the tone pushes waves, glass bubbles and droplets out of it, and the 165 Hz tone pulses beside it.

scenes.title: Ruler & Protractor
scenes.action: The last wave flattens into a line that grows graduations and opens the yellow world; the line becomes the ruler, which pulls back to a strip as the Surface Ruler and Protractor phones come in. An arm sweeps to 45 degrees with the Protractor and holds, then a marker measures 76.0 mm with the Surface Ruler, so both phones end on their results. The reading lifts to the left.

scenes.title: Unit Converter
scenes.action: Match cut on the reading: 76.0 mm lands where the converter's first card shows 76.0 mm, beside 7.6 cm. Four more categories follow on syncopated beats.

scenes.title: Tip & Bill Splitter
scenes.action: The two cards slide together and fold into one surface that becomes the receipt; the receipt prints, the tip appears and the total divides into two shares. Then a rest.

scenes.title: Decision Wheel
scenes.action: Hard cut on a strong accent. The choices land, a quiet beat, a wind-up, the spin, Music, and one burst of confetti.

scenes.title: Everyday tools, one app
scenes.action: Confetti pieces fly to a grid and become the app's tools as MaterialShape badges; the badges rise into a band while the five tools' real screens track in on the beat.

scenes.title: App Toolkit
scenes.action: Everything converges into the icon on the final downbeat; the name and the Get it on Google Play badge settle and hold.

transitions.name: Intro to Water Eject: the water shape grows into its world
Water Eject to Ruler: the last wave flattens into the ruler
Ruler to Unit Converter: match cut on 76.0 mm
Unit Converter to Bill: the cards fold into the receipt
Bill to Decision Wheel: a rest, then a hard cut on the accent
Decision Wheel to the toolkit: confetti becomes the tools
Toolkit to the icon: everything converges
